createoscillation.gui.goggles.coupler.li: Linked to a receiver %s blocks away
createoscillation.ponder.condenser.text_: The Condenser turns gases back into liquids and items. It needs no power
Pipe steam in. The first conversion takes a while...
...but once the Condenser is warm it keeps converting quickly while it is fed
Condensed liquid is pulled out by any pump or pipe
Some gases leave solids behind: Quartz Vapour gives water and quartz, dropped into the inventory below
Condensers can be built larger, up to 3x3 wide, for more capacity
createoscillation.ponder.frequency_bands: Speed sets the frequency: Low from 32 RPM, Mid from 64, High from 128, Ultrasonic at 256
Quartz Vapour needs the Mid band. In the Low band the quartz is left untouched
Gear up to 64 RPM and the recipe runs. Steam only forms in the Low band, so faster chambers keep their water
Goggles show the current band on the Resonator and the Chamber; JEI shows what each recipe needs
createoscillation.ponder.ore_chain.text_: Step 1: raw ore and water in a Resonance Chamber at the High band become Ore Slurry
Step 2: slurry and Steam in the Cavitation Chamber at the Ultrasonic band (256 RPM) become Metal Vapour
Step 3: a Condenser turns the vapour back into water and Metal Concentrate, two and a half per ore
Concentrate smelts into ingots. Any raw ore listed in the metals data map works
createoscillation.ponder.resonance_chamb: The Resonance Chamber holds items and fluids, like a Basin
With a Resonator spinning on top, Resonating recipes run: here water becomes Steam in the Low band
Gases are fluids: pull them out with a Resonance Pump into tanks and pipes
Right-click any side with an item to insert it; wear Goggles to see the frequency
createoscillation.ponder.resonance_coupl: A Resonance Emitter under a Resonator throws its vibration forward through open air
It needs a Tuned Crystal, and only emits while the Resonator runs in that crystal's band
A Resonance Receiver with a matching crystal turns the beam back into rotation at that band's speed
Anything solid in the way breaks the link; range is 16 blocks
Crystals of different bands ignore each other, so several links can cross the same room
Moving gases with the Resonance Pump
The Resonance Pump works like a Mechanical Pump, but only for gases
Steam flows from the left tank to the right one
Liquids are refused: water stays where it is
createoscillation.ponder.resonator.text_: The Resonator is a source of vibration. It does nothing on its own.
It takes rotation from a shaft on top and needs at least 32 RPM
Whatever sits directly below is shaken: a Resonance Chamber or a Vibrating Sieve
While the block below is working, the tuning fork shivers
createoscillation.ponder.sonic_pulverise: Breaking blocks with the Sonic Pulveriser
The Sonic Pulveriser is a Resonator turned sideways: any rotation drives it, but it needs a crystal to do anything
The crystal is its power and its tier: Low breaks 1 block, Mid 3x3 two deep, High 5x5 three deep, Ultrasonic 7x7 four deep
The nearest layer of blocks cracks together and shatters together; harder blocks take longer and cost more crystal
A filter limits what it breaks: set it to cobblestone and the stone stays
It burns one crystal at a time, like furnace fuel; hoppers and funnels can keep it fed. A spent crystal leaves a Rough Quartz Crystal to collect
createoscillation.ponder.tuning_fork.hea: Holding a frequency with the Tuning Fork
createoscillation.ponder.tuning_fork.tex: A fast shaft puts the Resonator in the High band, so Mid recipes will not run
The Tuning Fork sits between the shaft and the Resonator
Scroll on it to choose a frequency
Rotation passed downward is slowed to exactly that band: 64 RPM for Mid
A Low-Tuned Crystal and Rose Quartz resonated here grow into a Mid-Tuned Crystal; each tier is grown from the last
Slower input than the chosen band passes through unchanged: the fork cannot speed things up
createoscillation.ponder.vent.text_1: The Vent destroys any gas piped into it
createoscillation.ponder.vent.text_2: Handy for flushing a pipe network or disposing of by-products
createoscillation.ponder.vent.text_3: Liquids are refused, so nothing valuable is lost by accident
createoscillation.ponder.vibrating_sieve: The Vibrating Sieve is a mesh cage. It has no power of its own
A Resonator directly above shakes it (32 RPM or more)
Insert gravel, sand or similar through any open side: by hand, funnel or belt
What falls through the mesh lands in the inventory below: a depot, chest or belt
Results can also be extracted from the sides with funnels or hoppers
